messages:
Liam: Quick heads-up — reproducible mismatch between REST and JS SDK on our sampleapp. REST call to /v1/generate with `temperature:0` returns stable deterministic tokens; Node SDK generate({model:'redwood-1', temperature:0}) returns different output and sometimes 401 after ~200 reqs.
Nina: That's bad. Got logs?
Liam: pasted minimal curl + node snippet:
```
# curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hi","temperature":0}'

// node
await client.generate({model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi', temperature: 0})
```
Liam: REST shows `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 198` then 429 with `Retry-After: 1`, SDK shows 429 but no `retryAfter` in error object and backoff loop immediately rethrows.
Sam: What's the 401 after 200 reqs? Token rotation? maybe ephemeral creds TTL mismatch.
Ben: I think two separate drifts: (1) param name coercion — REST accepts `temperature` as number, SDK accidentally stringifies to `'0'` in x-www-form-urlencoded path when fallback happens, which some models treat differently. (2) retry handling — SDK's http client swallows `retry-after` header when response is from edge LB. Need to confirm.
Nina: Repro steps: run `tools/sampleapp/loadtest --mode=rest` and `--mode=sdk` for 30s, compare outputs. I saw same auth bump on dedicated env where KMS rotated key at 5m and SDK didn't refresh.
Liam: Attaching snippet of error from SDK:
```
Error: 429 Too Many Requests
  at HttpClient.request (/src/sdk/http.js:142)
  meta: { code: 'rate_limit', headers: {}} // headers empty
```
Nina: devex-bot: created issue github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1428 :eyes:
devex-bot: Deploy queued for sdk-auth-fix branch
Sam: Assigning to @Ben to triage. Ben — can you add a unit test for header passthrough and ensure `temperature` stays numeric in both code paths?
Ben: Yep. Also will add an integration test hitting the LB to validate `Retry-After` makes it into the Error.meta.retryAfter. I'll push a patch and link PR.
Liam: Quick question — should we change sampleapp docs to prefer JSON body instead of form fallback? That will reduce accidental stringification.
Nina: Yes, update quickstart to use JSON in samples. Also call out ephemeral credential refresh caveat in onboarding doc.
Ben: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2437
Sam: test plan: unit + e2e + update sampleapp cookbooks. ETA EOD tomorrow?
Ben: EOD sounds fine. I'll post updates here.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Nina: Adding `#sdk-parity` label to issue and linking to the onboarding checklist.
Ben: small note — we should bump telemetry metric when SDK sees header mismatch so we can surface in console.
Liam: thanks team, will add repro steps to the issue.
